items.q: Why separate the harness from where tools run?
items.a: For **security and isolation**—the agent loop and inference live apart from **untrusted tool code**.

items.q: What do shared volumes give agents?
items.a: A place to **collaborate** and store **self-improving memory** as plain files.
Teams want **path- and operation-level rules**, so they write a lightweight **sidecar proxy**.
**Inject them at the proxy** so the agent never sees secrets it could exfiltrate.

items.q: What observability does an agent need?
items.a: **Logs, metrics, GPU use and budget** it can read itself to debug and iterate.
